generation_recipes_scope: Includes historical generation studies and the current pinned master records. Current source selection is established by the producing manifest and its exact SHA256 pins; historical records are unchanged.
original_image_inputs_scope: Semantic visual references used to paint the current masters or their fixture ground. Originals remain reference-only and are not bundled as runtime PNGs; source masters are newly painted. Unit sprite planes retain their existing independent artwork provenance.

previous_acceptance.scope: Historical source set before the current redraw; not an approval of the current artwork.
previous_acceptance.text: Provisional new overhead mountain candidates. Independent art/code review, actualPNG ownership/assembly/bothparities pass. Isolatedquarter fallback shown as graphics proposal only; runtime selection NOT implemented. Fullmaps/materialvariation/fractionalzoom/nativecoverage/runtime/release acceptance remainopen.

profile: compound-v1: pre-allocation resource budget <=4,000,000 conservative full-support axis taps: (scene_width_4x+scene_height_4x) * (ceil(6*max(1,1/(4*uniform_scale)))+1), including out-of-source normalization work; <=32,000,000 retained weight bytes plus <=32,000,000 temporary kernel bytes; reject before weights allocate. Uniform whole-source pixel-edge affine to full 4x scene; transparent extension; separable antialiased premultiplied byte-RGB Lanczos3, signed lobes, source-space radius widened by reduction, output-only rounding and existing alpha/color clamp policy. Outer union boundary formed by reciprocal edge cancellation; reject any sampled alpha >=250 at signed distance <=8 world pixels before guard; alpha zero through 4 world pixels then smoothstep 4..8. Guard full unmasked 4x artwork, then existing resizeLanczos to whole-scene 2x. Ground independently exported by exportGrassBaseTiles in summer and unchanged exportConnectionTiles otherwise with fixed geometry and grass only, PNG decoded and assembled at exact tile origins; never sampled at scene origin. Compose artwork globally over actual ground PNG assembly, mask union only at final pixels; crop without filtering, final complementary top-left half-open ownership. Decode tile PNG bytes and reassemble ordinary image.Draw Over. Both runtime line parities use actual PNGs, ground first, compound second. Pixel-aligned 2x/4x only; no runtime/whole-map/user acceptance claim. Summer grass: unmirrored periodic bilinear source sampling. Per source axis, overlap=(size-1)/4 and span=3*(size-1)/4. At world phase t in [0,period), x=t/period*span. For x<overlap blend source(x+span) toward source(x) with cubic smoothstep(x/overlap); otherwise source(x). Apply separable windows on both axes, periods142,80. Round wrapped world phases to1e-9 before source lookup. Average RGB of f(x,y),f(x+71,y+40), then round half-up once. This is invariant under all six neighbor translations without reflected source marks. Non-grass materials, unseen and winter retain the existing sampler.
rebuild_note: Rebuilt to the user-supplied RefDesign visual target with shared detailed grass, earthworks, roads, crowns, rocks and huts; user visual approval remains open. Historical generation recipes retain their original provenance.
